basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm Alex, a Long Beach resident passionate about sustainable living and environmental conservation. I love gardening and have recently started composting to reduce my carbon footprint. On weekends, you can find me biking along the coast or exploring local farmers markets. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to engage with the community online, mostly in the evenings. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my free time learning about new eco-friendly practices and connecting with like-minded individuals.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in environmental science from my college days and have been self-teaching about sustainable living practices. My interest in composting started about a year ago after attending a community workshop.
